help.tourSub: Isikhokelo esikhawulezayo sokukhangela igama lakho lokuqala.

niqqud.s2: Igama lifumana iimpawu zezikhamiso ukuze ulifunde ngokuchanekileyo.

account.desc: Nyusela isicwangciso uze ulawule umrhumo wakho.
ui.sentencePh: (Uyazikhethela) Chwetheza isivakalisi apho kuvela khona igama ukuze ufumane intsingiselo enye echanekileyo
ui.gadHint: Cofa xa sele uliqondile, yaye igama liya kuphawulwa njengeliqondiweyo kwincwadi yakho
ui.savedNote: Eli gama neentsingiselo zalo zigcinwe kwincwadi yakho, yaye ziyafumaneka naxa ungekho kwi-intanethi
ui.compose: Bhala esakho isivakalisi uze uqinisekise ukuba usiqondile
ui.installAndroid: Faka ngokucofa kube kanye, iGadit ivuleka njenge-app yokwenene kwisikrini sakho sasekhaya.
ui.dupBody: Ufuna ukudibanisa kwakhona iprofayile ekhoyo? Onke amagama nenkqubela zigcinwa.
ui.reconnectNote: ✓ Ukudibanisa kwakhona kubuyisa onke amagama nenkqubela.
ui.joinSub: Chwetheza ikhowudi enamanani ama-6 eyenziwe ngumzali wakho
ui.kidsLine: abantwana aba-{n} kusapho · amagama ayi-{w} afundiweyo
ui.leaderSub: Amagama ahlukeneyo umntu ngamnye awakhangeleyo ukuza kuthi ga ngoku
ui.recentSub: Onke amagama abantwana bakho abawakhangeleyo, amatsha kuqala.
ui.alertsSub: Fumana izaziso ngazo zonke izinto ezenziwa ngabantwana bakho kwiGadit: amagama abawakhangelayo, iidikteshini, izifundo, imidlalo nokufunda.
ui.alertsSwitch: Ndixelele into eyenziwa ngabantwana bam kwiGadit
ui.alertNowSub: Isaziso nje bakhangela igama okanye begqiba ukuziqhelanisa.
ui.hwPickPicSub: Mamela igama uze ukhethe umfanekiso walo kwezintathu
ui.ranksSub: Uqokelele amagama angama-{n}. Igama ngalinye elitsha likunyusela phezulu
ui.toNext: Kusele amagama angama-{n} ukuze unyuke inqanaba
ui.readerSub: Ncamathelisa isicatshulwa, thatha ifoto yephepha, layisha umfanekiso okanye ubambe isikrini sakho.
ui.readerPh: Ncamathelisa isicatshulwa okanye umfanekiso wesikrini apha…
ui.tapHint: Cofa naliphi na igama ukuze ubone intsingiselo yalo. Amagama owavulileyo aba luhlaza.
ui.saySub: Chwetheza isivakalisi, khetha ulwimi olufundayo, uze uve kanye indlela yokusitsho.
ui.pasteListSub: Igama elinye kumgca ngamnye, ngolwimi lwakho okanye ngesiNgesi.
ui.pointsRule: Igama elitsha = inyathelo eliya phezulu · Ukuziqhelanisa okugqityiweyo = ii-skin ezintsha
ui.duelCardSub: Dlalani ninene: umzali nomntwana, abantakwenu okanye abahlobo.
ui.duelSub: Imibuzo efanayo kubadlali bobabini. Ochaneleyo nowakhawulezayo uyaphumelela.
ui.dSameSub: Dlulisani isixhobo phakathi kwabadlali kumbuzo ngamnye.
ui.dInviteSub: Thumela ikhowudi okanye ikhonkco kusapho okanye kumhlobo.
ui.dOnlineSub: Umdlali ongaziwayo onobudala obufana nobakho. Igama lesiqhulo ne-avatar kuphela, akukho magama okwenene kwaye akukho ncoko.
ui.duelKidsSub: Xa oku kuvuliwe, abantwana bakho banokudlala iWord Duel nabanye abantwana abalingana nabo abakwi-intanethi ngelo xesha. Babona kuphela igama lesiqhulo ne-avatar.
ui.familyLine: Ukuya kutsho kubantwana aba-5, kunye nabazali
ui.cxBody: Uya kuhlala unofikelelo olupheleleyo de kuphele ixesha lakho langoku. Ungabuya nanini na ngaphambi koko.
ui.pauseBody: Ungamisa umrhumo inyanga enye, ungahlawuli. Yonke into ihlala injalo, yaye umrhumo uqhubeka ngokwawo emva kwenyanga.
ui.renewTitle: Akukho ngxaki, siza kuvala uhlaziyo oluzenzekelayo
ui.renewBody: Uvavanyo lwakho luya kuqhubeka de luphele, yaye akuyi kubakho ntlawulo.
demo.mySentence: Ikati yam enomdla yavula ibhokisi nganye endlwini.
demo.feedbackMsg: Kuhle, usebenzise u-'curious' kanye ngendlela efanelekileyo.
demo.hwList: iapile, isikolo, umhlobo, tyheli, utitshala, igadi
search.desc: Chwetheza okanye uthethe igama uze ufumane zonke iintsingiselo zalo, imizekelo, umfanekiso nemvelaphi yalo.
search.s1: Chwetheza igama kwibhokisi yokukhangela, okanye cofa imakrofoni uze ulitsho.
search.s3: Cofa u-'Umfanekiso' phantsi kwentsingiselo ukuze ubone umfanekiso wayo.
search.s4: Ekupheleni: apho igama livela khona, emva koko iqhosha elithi 'Gad it!'.
save.title: Incwadi yakho iyazizalisa
save.desc: Lonke igama olikhangelayo ligcinwa ngokuzenzekelayo kwincwadi yakho.
save.s1: Lonke igama olikhangelayo lizigcina ngokwalo, akukho nto kufuneka uyicofe.
save.s2: Ukuze ubone amagama akho, vula u-'Incwadi' kwimenyu ephezulu.
save.s3: Onke amagama akho akhona apho, yaye kwizicwangciso ezihlawulelwayo asebenza nangaphandle kwe-intanethi.
save.s4: KwiBasic, incwadi yasimahla igcina ukuya kutsho kumagama angama-30.
context.title: Intsingiselo efanelekileyo yesivakalisi sakho
context.desc: Yongeza isivakalisi apho kuvela khona igama uze ufumane intsingiselo enye elingana nalo.
context.s1: Chwetheza igama, uze kwindawo engezantsi kwalo, chwetheze isivakalisi apho livela khona.
context.s2: IGadit ikunika intsingiselo enye elingana neso sivakalisi.
context.s3: Loo ndawo ikwakhona phantsi kwebha yokukhangela kwiphepha ngalinye legama.
wordpage.title: Okungakumbi ngegama ngalinye
wordpage.desc: Bhala esakho isivakalisi, fumana eminye imizekelo uze uphawule igama njengeliqondiweyo.
wordpage.s1: Phantsi kwentsingiselo, cofa u-'Bhala esakho isivakalisi uze uqinisekise ukuba usiqondile'.
wordpage.s2: Bhala okanye uthethe isivakalisi sakho, cofa u-'Jonga isivakalisi' uze ufumane ingxelo khona apho.
wordpage.s3: Kwizicwangciso ezihlawulelwayo, u-'+ Eminye imizekelo yezivakalisi' wongeza imizekelo emitsha emithathu.
wordpage.s4: Ekupheleni, cofa u-'Gad it!' yaye igama liya kuphawulwa njengeliqondiweyo kwincwadi yakho.
extras.title: Imibuzo ngegama
extras.desc: Kwizicwangciso ezihlawulelwayo: izichasi, amagama afanayo, usapho lwegama, iimpazamo eziqhelekileyo nendlela yokulikhumbula.
extras.s1: Emva ko-'Gad it!', u-'Unombuzo ngeli gama?' unika imibuzo emihlanu.
extras.s2: Cofa umbuzo yaye impendulo ivuleka ngezantsi kwawo.
kids.title: Kids Mode
kids.desc: Iswitshi enye kwibar ephezulu ichaza igama ngalinye ngendlela obunokulichazela ngayo umntwana.
kids.s1: KwiFamily, vula iswitshi ethi 'Abantwana' ecaleni kwelogo.
kids.s3: Xa ivuliwe, imenyu ibonisa u-'Umsebenzi wasekhaya' endaweni ka-'Ziqhelanise'.
kids.s4: Kwisixhobo esabelanwayo, vula u-'Shared kids screen' kwiMy family, yaye umntwana ngamnye acofe umfanekiso wakhe.
install.desc: Yongeza iGadit kwisikrini sakho sasekhaya kwi-iPhone, okanye uyifake kwi-Android.
install.s1: Kwi-iPhone, vula i-gadit.app kwiSafari uze ucofe iqhosha elithi Yabelana.
install.s2: Skrola, ukhethe u-'Yongeza kwiSikrini sasekhaya' uze ucofe u-'Yongeza'.
install.s3: Kwi-Android, faka i-app yeGadit kwiGoogle Play, okanye ucofe u-'Faka' kwiChrome.
install.s4: Ngoku iGadit ivuleka kwi-icon yayo, njengeyiphi na i-app.
addchild.title: Yongeza ilungu losapho
addchild.desc: Khetha indima, igama nombala, de kube kubantwana aba-5 kwiFamily.
addchild.s1: KwiMy family, kwithebhu yeFamily, cofa u-'Yongeza ilungu losapho'.
addchild.s2: Khetha indima: Utata, Umama, Unyana okanye Intombi.
addchild.s3: Chwetheza igama, khetha umbala, yongeza ubudala ukuba uyafuna, uze ucofe u-'Yongeza kusapho'.
addchild.s4: Ukuba igama sele likusapho, unokudibanisa loo profayile kwakhona uze ugcine amagama ayo.
pair.desc: Dibanisa isixhobo somntwana ngekhowudi ye-QR okanye ikhowudi enamanani ama-6.
pair.s1: Kwithebhu yeFamily, cofa u-'Dibanisa isixhobo' kwikhadi lomntwana.
pair.s2: Skena ikhowudi ye-QR ngesixhobo somntwana, okanye uvule i-gadit.app/join apho uze uchwetheze ikhowudi.
pair.s3: Kwi-iPhone, vula iGadit kwi-icon yesikrini sasekhaya uze ucofe u-'Faka ikhowudi'.
pair.s4: Chwetheza amanani ama-6, yaye umntwana odityaniswe kwakhona ufumana onke amagama akhe kwakhona.
dash.s1: Vula u-'My family' kwimenyu ye-avatar, yaye ithebhu ethi Ekhaya ishwankathela usapho.
dash.s2: Umntwana ngamnye unekhadi elinamagama, ulandelelwano, inqanaba namagama akutshanje.
dash.s3: Amanqanaba osapho abonisa ukuba ngamnye kuni ukhangele amagama amangaphi.
dash.s4: U-'Uphando lwakutshanje' udwelisa onke amagama abantwana abawakhangeleyo, amatsha kuqala.
alerts.title: Izaziso ngabantwana bakho
alerts.desc: Fumana iindaba ngamagama, iidikteshini, izifundo, imidlalo, ukufunda needueli.
alerts.s1: KwiMy family, kwiIisetingi, vula u-'Ndixelele into eyenziwa ngabantwana bam kwiGadit'.
alerts.s2: Khetha u-'Yonke into, kwangoko' okanye u-'Isishwankathelo semihla ngemihla'.
alerts.s3: Khetha into ofuna ukuva ngayo, uze uvule izaziso kube kanye kwisixhobo ngasinye.
alerts.s4: Izaziso zifika nge-imeyile, yaye njengebhena yefowuni apho kunokwenzeka.
homework.title: Umsebenzi wasekhaya
homework.desc: Kubantwana abakwiFamily: yongeza umsebenzi wasekhaya ngefoto okanye ngokuncamathisela, emva koko bawuziqhelanise.
homework.s1: Kwi-'Umsebenzi wasekhaya', cofa uThatha ifoto, Layisha okanye Ncamathelisa ukuze wongeze umsebenzi wasekhaya wanamhlanje ebusuku.
homework.s2: Jonga amagama, khetha ukuba yintoni na nokuba luvavanyo nini, uze ucofe uGcina.
homework.s3: Umsebenzi wasekhaya ulinda phantsi ko-'Okuza kwenziwa', ecaleni kokufunda amagama, ukufunda nokulungiselela uvavanyo.
homework.s4: U-'Ukufunda amagama' uneedikteshini, mamela ukhethe, umdlalo womfanekiso nezifundo zolwimi.
ranks.title: Amanqanaba, ulandelelwano namanqanaba osapho
ranks.desc: Igama elitsha ngalinye likusondeza kwinqanaba elilandelayo, yaye ukuziqhelanisa okugqityiweyo kuvula ii-skin ezintsha.
ranks.s1: Cofa ibheji yenqanaba kwibar ephezulu ukuze ubone amanqanaba akho.
ranks.s2: Igama ngalinye elitsha kwincwadi yakho likunyusela kumanqanaba.
ranks.s3: Abantwana babona ulandelelwano lweentsuku, injongo yeveki nenqanaba labo, yaye amanqanaba aphezulu avula imbonakalo emitsha.
ranks.s4: Amanqanaba osapho kwiMy family abonisa ukuba ngubani okhangele amagama amaninzi.
reader.desc: Thatha ifoto, ncamathelisa okanye ulayishe isicatshulwa, cofa naliphi na igama, emva koko uqinisekise ukuba usiqondile.
reader.s1: Kwi-'Every Word', ncamathelisa isicatshulwa, thatha ifoto yephepha, layisha umfanekiso okanye i-PDF, okanye wabelane ngesikrini sakho.
reader.s2: U-'Amagama aphambili kwesi sicatshulwa' ubonisa amagama afanele ukufundwa kuqala.
reader.s3: Cofa naliphi na igama ukuze ubone intsingiselo yalo, yaye igama ngalinye olivulayo lijika libe luhlaza.
reader.s4: Ekugqibeleni, uvavanyo lokufunda lubuza ukuba amagama athetha ukuthini kwisicatshulwa.
say.title: Yitsho ngolunye ulwimi
say.desc: Chwetheza isivakalisi, khetha ulwimi, silalele uze uziqhelanise nokusitsho.
say.s1: Kwi-'Say it', chwetheza okanye urekhode isivakalisi uze ukhethe ulwimi ofuna ukusiva ngalo.
say.s2: Cofa u-'Say it' uze uve kanye indlela esivakala ngayo.
say.s3: Emva koko cofa u-'Ziqhelanise nokusitsho' uze usitsho ngokuvakalayo.
say.s4: Ufumana ukuya kutsho kwiinkwenkwezi ezintlanu, nesikhokelo xa ingekafiki apho.
practice.title: Ziqhelanise
practice.desc: Kubantu abadala abakwiIndividual neFamily: ukufunda, ukulungiselela uvavanyo, idikteshini nolwimi.
practice.s2: Khetha kwenye kwezine: ukufunda, uvavanyo, idikteshini okanye ulwimi.
practice.s3: Ukuze ulungiselele uvavanyo, ncamathelisa uluhlu lwamagama uze uziqhelanise kude kube lusuku lolo.
practice.s4: Kwidedikteshini uva igama, ulibhale uze ubone upelo oluchanekileyo.
games.title: Imidlalo yamagama
games.desc: Imidlalo esekwe kumagama akwincwadi yakho, kunye neminye emininzi.
games.s3: Ezantsi kukho eminye imidlalo ngemvelaphi yamagama, amagama achanekileyo nokwakheka kwamagama.
games.s4: Umdlalo ngamnye ogqityiweyo ukusondeza kwi-skin entsha.
duel.title: Word Duel
duel.desc: Imibuzo efanayo nxamnye nosapho, umhlobo okanye iWord Bot.
duel.s2: Dlalani kwesi sixhobo, memani ngekhowudi okanye ikhonkco, joyinani ngekhowudi, okanye dlalani neWord Bot.
duel.s3: Ukuze adlale nomntu okwi-intanethi ngoku, umzali uvula u-'Word Duel nabanye abantwana' kwiIisetingi.
duel.s4: Ochaneleyo nowakhawulezayo uyaphumelela, yaye itheyibhile yoloyiso igcina amanqaku.
account.s1: Vula u-'Iakhawunti' kwimenyu ye-avatar ukuze ubone isicwangciso sakho.
account.s2: KwiBasic, cofa u-'Phuculela kwiFamily' okanye u-'Phuculela kwiIndividual'.
account.s4: Kwisicwangciso esihlawulelwayo, u-'Lawula iintlawulo' no-'Tshintsha isicwangciso' benza okuseleyo.
cancel.title: Rhoxisa, misa okanye cima uhlaziyo
cancel.desc: Kwenzeka ntoni xa urhoxisa, nezinye iindlela ezithambileyo endleleni.
cancel.s1: KwiAkhawunti, cofa u-'Cancel subscription' uze ukhethe isizathu ukuba uyafuna.
cancel.s2: Kwisicwangciso senyanga, ungamisa inyanga enye endaweni yokurhoxisa, ungahlawuli.
cancel.s3: Kuvavanyo lwasimahla, isizathu esithi 'Bendingafuni kuhlawuliswa ngokuzenzekelayo' sikuvumela ukuba ucime nje uhlaziyo.
cancel.s4: Ukuba utshintsha ingqondo, cofa u-'Ndirhoxise ngempazamo, gcina umrhumo'.
